acceptance: Delimited output is SHA-256 identical to bundled dsdgen (--compat c NULL vs empty-string and UTF-8 parity) for all 24 tables at SF 1 and 10, at 1 thread and default threads.
Parquet bytes are thread-invariant on macOS arm64 and Linux x86_64; bidirectional EXCEPT ALL = 0 against dsdgen-converted Parquet.
N=3 medians meet the ADR budget: SF 1 <= 3 s / <= 4 s, SF 10 <= 30 s / <= 40 s, RSS <= 1,024 MiB / <= 2,048 MiB.
The native backend accepts tpcds at SF >= 1 and refuses SF < 1 loudly until datagen-lib-tpcds-fractional-and-refresh lands.
description:
TPC-DS stage (docs/internal/adr/adr-benchbox-datagen.md (revised 2026-11-26, PR #4540), decisions 1 and 3). Depend on tpcdsgen and tpcdsgen-arrow by exact version; delimited and Parquet output for the 24 benchmark tables only.

Guardrails: no fork of tpcgen-rs; no auto backend mode or silent fallback; Python stays the only manifest writer; heavy measurements only through make heavy-run with N=3 medians recorded in the PR body; budgets from the ADR table are the gate, and a miss goes to the owner rather than being waived.
